content: God enters by a private door into every individual.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Spiritual insight is deeply personal. Divine wisdom does not require an intermediary church or priest; it speaks directly through the quiet sanctuary of your own soul.
practicalInsight: Honor your direct personal relationship with the sacred without needing third-party approval.
reflectionPrompt: What does the quiet voice of the divine say to your heart in this moment?
